_comment_1: Copy this file to deploy_config.local.json (next to deploy_ignition_module.py) and fill in your own values.
_comment_2: deploy_config.local.json is git-ignored — your API token will NOT be committed.
_comment_3: Generate an API token in: Gateway → Config → Security → API Keys. It needs permission to manage modules and restart the gateway.
_comment_4: Lookup order per value: command line, then IGNITION_GATEWAY_URL / IGNITION_API_TOKEN, then --config FILE, then %APPDATA%/ctg-module/deploy.json, then this file (as deploy_config.local.json). A malformed file is an error (exit 2).
